metrics.label: Payment reliability
metrics.definition: Attempted payments that reached the succeeded terminal state with a receipt, over all attempted payments.

metrics.label: Repeated-callback recovery
metrics.definition: Attempted payments where a replayed provider callback changed nothing, over all attempted payments.

metrics.label: Receipts issued for succeeded payments
metrics.definition: Succeeded payments that produced a receipt, over all succeeded payments.

metrics.label: User task completion
metrics.definition: Seeded end-to-end user tasks that completed the expected outcome, over all seeded tasks.
